headline: Diversity provides variety—different perspectives, skills, and approaches that strengthen the whole
universal_truth: Sameness is fragile; diversity is resilient; difference enables what similarity cannot
fun_facts: Diverse teams consistently outperform homogeneous teams on complex problems
Ecosystems with high biodiversity are more resilient to disruption
The most innovative companies actively cultivate cognitive diversity
discussion_questions: How does diversity benefit the groups you're in?
When has a different perspective helped you see something new?
Where do you seek similarity and where do you value difference?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: A forest with one tree species is vulnerable to any disease that attacks that species. A forest with diverse species survives what kills monocultures. Diversity isn't just nice—it's strategically essential for resilience and innovation.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Similarity is comfortable. Why deliberately seek difference?

options.text: Diversity provides range—different perspectives see different things, different skills solve different problems; homogeneity is efficient but fragile; diversity is resilient and creative
options.response: Yes. What you don't see, someone else does. What you can't do, someone else can. Diversity expands collective capability beyond any individual or any uniform group.
Fairness matters, but diversity also provides practical benefits—better problem-solving, greater resilience...

q1.title: Cognitive Diversity
q1.script: Diversity of thought matters as much as demographic diversity. Different thinking styles, problem-solving approaches, and perspectives create cognitive range that outperforms uniformity.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Cognitive Diversity"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Resilience Through Variety
q2.script: Sameness creates single points of failure. What kills one kills all. Variety means some will survive whatever comes. Diversity is insurance against the unpredictable.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Discomfort of Difference
q3.script: Diversity is harder. Agreement is faster with similar people. But the friction of difference produces better outcomes. Value the productive discomfort of engaging difference.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Sameness is fragile; diversity is resilient. Difference enables what similarity cannot. Seek and value variety.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 326. Tomorrow, we'll explore making room for everyone—inclusion. Until then, appreciate the diversity around you.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Diversity Check - What Variety Do You Have?
growTrack.learning_objective: Assess and expand exposure to diversity
growTrack.activity: Consider your circles: friends, colleagues, information sources. How diverse are they? Where do you have variety and where do you have similarity? What could you do to expand the range of perspectives you encounter?
